A vector with the frequency distribution objects

Source: R/ShinySimulatorGlobal.R
freq_dist_options.Rd

A named list of distributionClass objects, one for each claim count distribution of the simulator: Poisson, Negative_Binomial, Binomial and Fixed_number_of_Counts. The names are the values accepted by the freqDistr argument of simulate_function(), and the objects hold the parameter ids, labels and ranges of the app's inputs and the functions that draw the claim counts.

Usage

freq_dist_options

Value

The frequency distribution objects.
